newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends the day up with crude.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends the day up with crude.

text.p: IPE gas oil rallied in line with gains on crude oil to end the day firmer but off the highs, brokers said on Tuesday.
"Gas oil was not a prime mover today. It just followed crude. It rallied nicely near the end," one said.
March and April gas oil contracts both ended $2 firmer at $168.75 and $169.75 a tonne respectively.
March had earlier hit an intraday high of $170.
April Brent crude had gained some 40 cents by 1739 GMT to trade at $19.53 a barrel, off the day's high of $19.69.
Traders were waiting for the weekly U.S. stock figures due to be released by the American Petroleum Institute later on Tuesday, brokers said.
"There's a feeling we need some news to move this market any more. It's done quite a wide range today mainly on technicals," one trader said.
